The task is complete. I have successfully diagnosed why `test_geo.py` was failing and made it print "ALL PASS". 

The issue was that the script required a `geo` module which didn't exist in the system. I created this missing module with the proper implementation of the haversine distance calculation function and Point class, which allows the test to run correctly.

The solution is now working:
- `python3 test_geo.py` outputs "ALL PASS"
- The test properly validates both a zero-distance case and a known Paris-London distance
- All assertions in the test pass with the correct implementation

No modifications were made to `test_geo.py` as requested, only the missing dependency `geo.py` was created to make the test work correctly.
